## Summary

- What changed?
- Why was it needed?
- Which requirement and acceptance scenario IDs are affected?
- For an intent change, link the human acceptance decision and describe the delta.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran relevant tests locally
- [ ] I included logs/screenshots for behavior changes
- [ ] I updated docs where needed
- [ ] Changed accepted requirements have a reviewed decision and matching baseline digest
- [ ] I regenerated changed cases and reviewed their test-map coverage assertions

## Risk

- [ ] No behavioral risk
- [ ] Low risk (localized)
- [ ] Medium/high risk (call out details below)

Risk notes:

## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets or private keys were committed
- [ ] CI workflow impact considered
- [ ] Backward compatibility considered
